integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible standard-library witness checker; independent external scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Dimension only for n>=4 and support sizes k=2,3; no shape classification or k>=4 assertion; finite checker supports explicit witnesses but infinite argument is analytical. A three-label ternary witness was already implicit in Babson et al.
title: Full parameter dimension for binary and ternary independent ranking laws
